summary: scripts/review: the credential scan no longer reads git repositories under the account's credential directories (their FETCH_HEAD, refs and objects hold public commit ids and made every verdict naming that head fail), but still reads each repository's config, where a remote URL can carry a token. Public key files (*.pub, known_hosts, authorized_keys) are not scanned either.

replay.detail: scripts/review and scripts/review-test (local review tooling) only; no protocol, schema, policy, workflow or note change.

compatibility.detail: Narrows which files feed the secret scan; a real key or token file is still caught (tested).

recovery.detail: Revert; verdicts naming a scratch repository's head fail again.
